summary: This is a Docker Compose configuration that sets up a service called open-webui. It pulls a pre-built container image, exposes it on port 4000, configures it to connect to an Ollama service, and creates persistent storage for the application's data.

explanations.4: The service will automatically restart if it crashes, unless you manually stop it.
explanations.6: This maps port 4000 on your computer to port 8080 inside the container, so you access the app by visiting localhost:4000.
explanations.8: This tells the container where to find the Ollama service (which provides the AI models); host.docker.internal is Docker's way of referring to your host machine from inside a container.
explanations.9: This is a security key that the application uses for encryption; you should replace this placeholder with an actual random string before running in production.
explanations.11: This creates a persistent storage volume so that the application's data survives even if the container is deleted and recreated.
explanations.13: This adds a hostname mapping inside the container so it can properly resolve 'host.docker.internal' to your host machine's gateway.
